classification: implemented external-source importer, restricted tiers
route: pyslang 11.x extractor -> sv-0.1 JSON envelope -> Lean AST/interpreters
semantics: Four-state values, fuel-bounded cycle scheduler with legal schedule oracle; separate timed Active/Inactive/NBA loader; trace/refinement proofs for accepted fragments
trust_and_limitations: Python/slang translation trusted; schema is not Yosys JSON; M0 uses an implicit single posedge clock; timed/cycle adequacy is stated, not generally proved; unsupported nodes can be rejected at execution; no fresh Lean build in this survey

classification: implemented external-source importer, two-state subset
route: pyslang 11.0.0 elaboration -> Python AST/IR normalization -> Lean source + compile gate
semantics: Generated Bool/BitVec combinational and state transition functions; corpus model-level proofs
trust_and_limitations: Lean 4.26.0 pinned; frontend/codegen unverified; rejects unsupported constructs; corpus theorem acceptance does not establish arbitrary RTL/model equivalence or full Yosys-generated-cell coverage

classification: implemented partial importer with unsound acceptance paths
route: Lean lexer/parser -> internal hardware IR -> simulation/proof source
semantics: Executable circuit DSL and generated model/proofs for a subset
trust_and_limitations: Failed always blocks are skipped; missing submodules become warning wires and are skipped; unsupported verification expressions emit sorry; assertion macro emits by sorry. All 18 inspected parser-bearing forks inherited these three principal gaps

classification: implemented restricted source translator
route: Regex source parser preserves symbolic parameters -> deterministic Lean generator
semantics: Bool/BitVec step/output/run; generic step-to-trace theorem; small-width exhaustive co-simulation
trust_and_limitations: Regex parser; width syntax [HI:0], no inout, no always_comb in generator; exhaustive WIDTH=1,2,3 checks do not prove translator correctness for every width; not a general arbitrary Yosys netlist reader

classification: embedded Verilog-like syntax and semantics, not unchanged file reader
route: Lean v![...] syntax macros -> AST -> transition semantics
semantics: Expression/statement/module semantics with explicit notSupported results
trust_and_limitations: Verilog apostrophe literals are replaced by # to fit Lean lexer; no read_file/Yosys netlist import found; no fresh build or language-adequacy proof established

classification: proved canonical emitted-format parser, not arbitrary Yosys import
route: AAG-derived graph -> rigid SV text; parseSystemVerilog decodes that exact grammar
semantics: Proved text roundtrip and decoded graph execution correspondence
trust_and_limitations: Requires hd_top/hd_m_* generated names and HD_GATES/HD_LITERALS scaffolding; proof is for self-emitted shape, not IEEE-wide or general write_verilog output. Lean4.35.0 pinned

classification: output-only compiler
route: Lean Mealy descriptions -> compiler netlist -> SystemVerilog emission
semantics: Lean-side Mealy semantics; generated hardware descriptions
trust_and_limitations: SystemVerilog generator is not an external SV/Yosys reader

classification: actual Yosys-schema bridge into Lean
route: scripts/yosys_to_loom_ir.py reads Yosys modules/netnames/cells/connections/parameters -> neutral JSON schema1 or hierarchy schema2 -> Lean ImportJson and checked ImportIR lowering
semantics: Executable two-state BitVec expressions, register/memory cycles, stateless/hierarchical components; explicit partial-value refinement choices
trust_and_limitations: Yosys and Python adapter explicitly untrusted; accepted cell subset not arbitrary technology library; external equivalence/signoff remains required; unsafe implemented_by memoization used at runtime. Lean4.28.0 pinned; two Python adapter probes run, no Lean build

classification: related predecessor/copy of actual Yosys bridge

semantics: Same Loom semantic architecture

classification: actual auxiliary schema use, semantic importer is Functional SMT
route: write_json intermediate circuit metadata/effects/initial constraints; actual transfer function via write_functional_smt2
semantics: Generated Lean BitVec/memory transition functions from FunctionalIR
trust_and_limitations: Do not label JSON alone as direct full netlist semantics. Its .table.json is an internal Lean runtime interface, not Yosys write_table. Root separately exercised production memory RTL translation; no Lean compiler available

classification: port-metadata consumer, not JSON semantic importer

semantics: Main certified semantics/certificate flow is via AIGER/LRAT (separate survey)
